prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. ONE transparent portrait sprite for Legend of Mortal.
Image 1 is the edit target: preserve its exact pose, expression, gestures, fingers, props, sweat/blood and effects. Image 2 is the approved identity master: match its refined face, hairstyle, costume and hand-painted treatment only; do not paste its neutral expression or pose over Image 1.
Character: adult male Tang Buyi, same angular handsome face, dark ponytail, slate-blue robe, leather wrist guards and gold details as Image 2.
Required target emotion: A restrained warm amused closed-mouth smile, gently lifted brows and relaxed eyes, as in Image 1; no aura.
Keep the original natural head-to-shoulder ratio; never enlarge the face. Rough pencil/ink lines and textured watercolor/gouache, no photographic skin, smooth 3D, modern anime or chibi. Complete all original visible hands and props.
FRAME THE FIGURE SLIGHTLY SMALLER so the entire silhouette, all hair, sleeves, parasol and aura are surrounded by at least 5% truly transparent empty canvas on the TOP, LEFT AND RIGHT. Do not let any prop touch a side edge. No close-up. Lower robe can end at the bottom edge as originally, but no hands cropped. True RGBA transparent background, no painted background/checkerboard/shadow, no text or watermark.

checks.visual_review: Passed: approved facial identity, target expression and effects, original pose/props, natural head proportions, complete visible edges; bottom robe/hand placement follows original composition.
